title: Operator Guild Launch Playbook — Private Deployments (RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS)
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create an operator-centric launch playbook and cross-team coordination plan for the Private/VPC/On-prem GA that covers RBAC, audit logging, and KMS integration. The playbook will be the single source of truth for launch day runbooks, release notes, customer enablement kits, internal training, legal/compliance signoffs, and prioritized follow-up work. Goal: ensure customers adopting private deployments receive consistent security posture guidance, clear upgrade/migration steps, and predictable support SLA handoffs.
tasks: Draft GA release notes and feature matrix (owner: Docs)
Compile operator runbook for on-call / SRE teams (owner: SRE)
Produce customer enablement kit: migration checklist, how-to videos, sample policy templates (owner: Solutions Engineering)
Coordinate legal & compliance sign-off for KMS and audit retention policies (owner: Legal)
Finalize RBAC role definitions and default policies for Console and API (owner: Security)
Add telemetry tags and dashboard events for private deployments to Console observability (owner: Observability)
Prepare staged comms schedule for Early Access -> GA waves with customer cohorts (owner: GTM)
Schedule 2 operator training sessions + one recorded deep-dive for the Operator Guild (owner: Developer Relations)
Validate upgrade/migration scenarios end-to-end with Dedicated and Private stacks (owner: QA)
Publish support playbook and triage flows for CS/Support with runbook links (owner: Support)
Lock release notes copy, localization scope and translation deadlines (owner: Docs)
Create quick rollback and fallback checklist (owner: Platform Engineering)
Coordinate console UI microcopy and feature flags for staged rollout (owner: Product Design)
Confirm pricing & billing signals for dedicated/private usage (owner: Finance)
Plan post-GA follow-up backlog for top-5 customer requests (owner: PM)
Ensure audit logs meet regional retention/compliance constraints for EU and APAC (owner: Compliance)
Create example Terraform and Helm snippets for on-prem installs (owner: Infra)
Publish SDK notices for new private endpoints and token scoping (owner: SDK)
Create a public-facing FAQ and known-limits doc for GA (owner: Docs)
Run final cutover checklist and readiness review 72/24/6 hours before GA (owner: PM)
acceptance_criteria: Release notes approved by Docs + Legal and published in product changelog
Operator runbook published and validated by SRE with at least one drill pass
KMS configuration guide and sample KMS policies published; Legal signs off on key management model
RBAC role set landed in Console and test orgs show expected enforcement
Support has playbook + triage matrix and has completed knowledge-transfer session
Telemetry and dashboards show private deployment events in staging and prod telemetry pipelines
Localization for top 3 languages (en, fr, de) scheduled and in flight for GA
Customer enablement kit uploaded to shared drive with video and migration checklist
